The '''K7 "Black Dagger" Security Droid''' was a model of [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] produced by [[Rim Securities/Legends|Rim Securities]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] employed K7s as security at the Imperial military facility at [[Graith starport]].
